conversation.assistant: The Climate Adaptation Forum brings together experts, thought leaders, and diverse speakers and attendees from local, national, and global organizations across multiple sectors [1]. The forum focuses on topics including climate adaptation and resilience, infrastructure resilience, environmental justice, and innovative adaptation strategies [1].
